verdict.rationale: Travel booking is a fair question for a corporate spend management platform, but the evidence pack never mentions booking flights or hotels inside Clara, or applying a travel policy at booking time. The closest evidence is card-level merchant-category restrictions and auto-deleting trip cards. Those are adjacent card controls, not in-platform booking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can book flights and hotels in-platform with travel policy applied at booking time, not expensed and argued about later
